package sandbox

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/llm/safecall"
	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/pkg/types"
)

// 直接调用缺 WithPurpose：只声明了思考档位。
func selftestMissingPurpose(ctx context.Context, p protocol.Provider) {
	_, _ = safecall.Infer(ctx, p, nil, types.WithThinkingMode(types.ThinkingDisabled))
}
